:::{#def-cv-se-indexed}
#### Fold-based standard error of a named procedure

The **fold-based standard error of procedure** $\fitproc$ on a training set $\trainset$,
$\cvseof{\nfolds}{\fitproc}\paren{\trainset}$,
is the [fold-based standard error](#def-cv-se)
computed from the [fold sMSEs of $\fitproc$](#def-fold-mse-indexed):

$$
\cvseof{\nfolds}{\fitproc}\paren{\trainset} \eqdef \frac{\hSD{\foldmseof{1}{\fitproc}\paren{\trainset}, \ldots, \foldmseof{\nfolds}{\fitproc}\paren{\trainset}}}{\sqrt{\nfolds}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-se-indexed}

:::
